notes.title: Steam Page Up + Very Early Alpha Prototype (Version 1.13)
notes.notes:
Hi everbody!

Get your bowls, because we've got some soup to serve! First off, we've got a steam page now! Wishlist now if you want to support this project, it helps a lot! Secondly, we've made an updated demo with new improved quality updates, very noice! 

Changelog Demo 1.13:

- Punch lag fixes
- 24FPS Animations (Very Smooth)
- Clearer thunder critical spots
- New emotes for Coach Hank
- Faster restarts after defeat
- A new suprise funny ending

Wishlist Now to developers smile!
